Switched Round024 to sequential low-memory step-by-step execution: (1) T5 fold-local matrices computed first then T5 rebuilder immediately freed via del+gc.collect() before S1/LightGBM; (2) S1 features built one period at a time with per-period del+gc.collect(); (3) LightGBM fits executed sequentially one variant at a time with threads=1 (n_jobs=1), BELOW_NORMAL_PRIORITY_CLASS, and immediate del+gc.collect() after each model save.
